name: Magna Carta Reissued as Statute
summary: Henry III of England reissues Magna Carta in a revised form in exchange for a grant of taxation, the version that becomes the permanent foundation of English constitutional law. The 1225 version is entered into the English statute books and repeatedly confirmed by subsequent kings.

_quarry.structural_significance: The 1225 reissue is the version that enters statutory law; parliamentary confirmation of Magna Carta in exchange for taxes establishes the principle of no taxation without consent that drives English constitutional development.
